description: Use this when the user has no site yet and asks where to look, e.g. "areas in Ohio on 345 kV with gas within 8 km" or "which Texas markets could take 200 MW within 24 months?". mode areas (default) needs a geography (state, or lat and lon with radius_km) and returns search areas anchored on real substations with measured distances, plus applied_filters and constraint_coverage showing which filters ran. mode markets returns a market shortlist filtered by capacity_mw, region, state, iso and max_months. Results are search areas or markets, not parcels, listings or land for sale. Score one with evaluate_site.

capacity_mw.description: Target load in MW; filters markets mode, echoed only in areas mode

iso.description: Grid operator filter for markets mode, for example ERCOT

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees, for example 39.04

limit.description: Maximum results, default set by the source

lon.description: Longitude in decimal degrees, for example -77.48

max_fiber_km.description: Maximum distance to fiber in km (areas mode)

max_gas_km.description: Maximum distance to a gas pipeline in km (areas mode)

max_months.description: Maximum time to power in months (markets mode)

min_voltage_kv.description: Minimum substation voltage in kV (areas mode), for example 345

radius_km.description: Search radius around lat/lon in km, for example 60

region.description: Region filter for markets mode, for example TX or us

state.description: Two-letter US state, for example OH

name: find_sites
title: Find candidate areas or markets
